cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort, so I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Yourself means without burdening you. Let me arrange a mover; please leave the planning to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My brother will do it if you hold the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means keeping it still. Pass me the wedge, please; then I can supervise without blocking his path.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 professionally redefines yourself as delegated effort and A5 holding as immobilization, agreeing throughout while preserving A's supervisory role.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 keep requesting concrete assistance and supply an available helper, credible moving needs.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 exact holding condition to comply verbally while replacing manual effort with a tool.
